svg.aria-label: The estate: the public estate-baseline holds the standard, a private overlay pins it and adds the values, and every repository pulls both; checks fail on a leaked secret, on drift from the manifest and, before a public push, on any private identifier.
svg.title: The standard is public; the values stay private

svg.text: Nothing pushes into a repository: each one pulls the baseline at a pinned commit, so an update is an ordinary commit that CI checks.

text.font-family: MF Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Handoffs between coding agents go through an on-disk mailbox, so the trail survives the session.
